svg.title: A mascot reacts while a small app checks an uploaded file
svg.desc: Tessa sits beside a small Shiny-style form called Upload a dataset. She starts idle with the status Ready when you are. When the Validate button is pressed she wiggles, turns thinking and says Checking the rows while a bar scans the table. She then wiggles and turns worried, Two dates need a look, and the date column turns amber. Both dates are corrected, Validate is pressed again, and she wiggles into a happy face with All checks passed, then goes back to idle. The server code line under the picture changes with each mood.
